label: born in
definition: Person X was born in geographical place Y.
scope_notes: Declare the coherent birthplace meaning from dominant born-in/born-into-family-in paths. Growing up, schooling, residence, nationality, work or later travel alone does not establish birthplace. This is a new explicit meaning where the prior common catalogue has no matching sampled relation.

facts.reason: Mr. Lee is explicitly born in Taiwan; native/grow/director and visit paths are additional meanings.
Rushdie is explicitly born in Bombay and into a family there.
Sheng is explicitly born in Shanghai; study and student acceptance are additional meanings.
Leach is explicitly born in England in the supplied row.
Yu Cho is explicitly born in Korea in the supplied row.
